title: Which witch is which?

themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 4 champion buffs, 6 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: Which witch is which? Structured changes across 14 entities this patch.

champions.name: Amumu
champions.tldr: Base damage reduced to 70–170 from 70–190.; Mana cost increased to 70 at all ranks from 30–50.
champions.gameplayImpact: Amumu loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Base damage
lines.note: Base damage reduced to 70–170 from 70–190.

lines.label: Mana cost
lines.note: Mana cost increased to 70 at all ranks from 30–50.

champions.name: Anivia
champions.tldr: Base voice lines have been remastered to sound clearer, cleaner, and smoother.
champions.gameplayImpact: Anivia was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Base voice lines have been remastered to sound clearer, cleaner, and smoother.
